name: SMC Wing field near N83 (Hubble)
blurb: A field in the Wing of the Small Magellanic Cloud near the star-forming region N83, seen by Hubble.
label: smcwingn83field-hubble
story: The Wing of the Small Magellanic Cloud has been pulled out by tidal forces, and nearby N83 is a nursery of new stars. Hubble studied the stars in this field to map, in three dimensions, the gas and dust that lie between them and us.

claims.text: The program studies the tidally disrupted Wing of the SMC
N83/N84 are star-forming regions of the Small Magellanic Cloud
N83-F13-WFC is a field of the N83 region (HII region, molecular cloud, star-forming region)
Hubble uses resolved stars to map the 3D gas distribution of the interstellar medium
The goals involve tidal interactions and bursts of star formation
